skills.name: design
skills.description: Design user flows, interaction states and screen specifications from clear product intent, or route visual direction, alternatives, prototypes, design systems and craft review. Use for UX/UI design and textual engineering handoffs as well as visual artifacts. Product policy and scope stay with PM; production implementation stays with Dev.

skills.name: agent-routing
skills.description: Select executor and runtime bindings when dispatching or escalating a delegated controller, worker, or bounded agent.

skills.name: dev
skills.description: Deliver one coding-ready issue through its PR, review, CI, merge, and test handoff. Use for the full issue lifecycle, not ordinary bounded edits or multi-issue scheduling.

skills.name: dev-api-research
skills.description: Research third-party API or SDK capabilities and integration contracts when external behavior needs clarification.

skills.name: dev-api-steward
skills.description: Maintain owned backend/API contracts and client-facing documentation when implementation may change API behavior or compatibility.

skills.name: dev-ci-repair
skills.description: Repair red PR checks or repeated CI/environment failures escalated by dev-test. Initial implementation validation belongs to dev-test.

skills.name: dev-debugger
skills.description: Diagnose an observed defect, regression, crash, or unexplained test failure and return an evidence-backed root-cause brief before repair.

skills.name: dev-git-setup
skills.description: Prepare or reconcile an issue branch and isolated worktree for coding-ready Dev work, preserving existing checkouts and verifying integration bases.

skills.name: dev-implementer
skills.description: Implement approved changes and repair PR review findings or conflicts, preserving scoped ownership and current validation evidence.

skills.name: dev-integration-manager
skills.description: Coordinate integration of an explicit PR or branch set when merge order, cross-branch contracts, conflicts, or combined validation need a shared checkpoint.

skills.name: dev-merge-handoff
skills.description: Gate and complete one issue PR merge into the resolved integration base, cleanup, and test-revision handoff. Production promotion belongs to release.

skills.name: dev-planner
skills.description: Design approved engineering work, decide task boundaries, and prepare implementation-ready ticket plans. Use for technical choices, decomposition, or concrete implementation planning; not execution scheduling.

skills.name: dev-pr-writer
skills.description: Prepare, push, and open or reuse a GitHub PR from implemented work with validation evidence; supports explicitly requested drafts.

skills.name: dev-project-orchestrator
skills.description: Plan or execute multiple dev-ready issues as dependency waves or an ordered merge sequence. Single-issue delivery belongs to dev.

skills.name: dev-spike
skills.description: Investigate unresolved technical feasibility or competing implementation paths before architecture. Observed defects belong to dev-debugger first.

skills.name: dev-test
skills.description: Run post-implementation validation under the selected Dev mode and classify failures before PR preparation.

skills.name: dev-verifier
skills.description: Audit completion claims against fresh tests, runtime evidence, acceptance criteria, and an exact revision. Independent technical review belongs to review.

skills.name: deploy-skill-creator
skills.description: Create or update a repository-local deploy skill when a project needs its evidenced deployment and verification procedure captured.

skills.name: release
skills.description: Orchestrate a production release under repository policy, including promotion, tag, optional project deployment, and GitHub Release. Excludes ordinary issue delivery.

skills.name: repo-initialize
skills.description: Initialize or update a repository's AGENTS.md and optional .agents policies from the agent repository template while preserving project-specific rules.

skills.name: issue-router
skills.description: Select one read-only workflow route for a bound Linear issue or project before PM, Dev, investigation, verification, or release.

skills.name: pm
skills.description: Drive one product issue to development readiness, including intake, missing decisions, canonical specification, and a verified Dev handoff. Route multi-issue work to pm-project-orchestrator.

skills.name: pm-backlog
skills.description: Draft independently valuable issue slices and dependencies from stable product scope. Hand authorized tracker creation to pm-project-orchestrator.

skills.name: pm-bug-triage
skills.description: Clarify expected versus actual behavior, impact, severity, and actionable evidence before engineering diagnoses a bug.

skills.name: pm-data-analytics
skills.description: Design feature success metrics, event semantics, and privacy-aware measurement plans. Excludes analyzing datasets or implementing dashboards.

skills.name: pm-pr-product-review
skills.description: Compare an implemented PR with confirmed product requirements and acceptance criteria; assess conformance without implementing fixes.

skills.name: pm-project-orchestrator
skills.description: Structure a Linear project or coordinate PM readiness across related issues, including decomposition of an umbrella issue.

skills.name: pm-project-status
skills.description: Read current Linear project and roadmap status, milestone health and shipment evidence. Use for a project status report; route scope changes to Product and issue/PR delivery mutations to Develop.

skills.name: pm-readiness-review
skills.description: Assess whether one issue has sufficient confirmed product scope and acceptance evidence to begin development; return one combined readiness and Dev handoff result.

skills.name: pm-release-learning
skills.description: Draft evidence-backed release notes or summarize post-release product learning from shipped changes and feedback.

skills.name: pm-scope
skills.description: Clarify the user problem, desired outcome, and smallest coherent product scope with meaningful non-goals and proposed tradeoffs before specification.

skills.name: pm-solution-review
skills.description: Review a confirmed product solution for unnecessary complexity and unsupported rules while preserving its goal. Excludes strategy, design, and code review.

skills.name: pm-spec
skills.description: Synthesize confirmed product scope or a diagnosed bug into a concise PRD or canonical issue title and description.

skills.name: pm-strategy
skills.description: Shape product direction, roadmap priorities, and evidence-backed investment recommendations before project commitment.

skills.name: proj-closeout
skills.description: Prepare a project completion review, handover and retrospective against approved goals and actual delivery evidence. Keep outstanding impact measurement and follow-up ownership explicit.

skills.name: proj-context
skills.description: Build or refresh a project onboarding context pack from existing documents and relevant sources. Reuse known project materials; use proj-sources when discovery is needed.

skills.name: proj-kickoff
skills.description: Turn an approved project proposal into kickoff material and a reusable Project Entry Page. Use for execution alignment, scope, roles, resources and milestones; does not schedule meetings or create delivery issues.

skills.name: proj-proposal
skills.description: Write or refine a stakeholder project proposal, including a short go/no-go brief, using available context and evidence. Use for an investment or resource decision; approved execution setup belongs to proj-kickoff.

skills.name: proj-review
skills.description: Review a proposal, kickoff, project update or closeout document for decision quality, evidence and consistency. Return findings and readiness; does not approve the project or edit the document unless separately authorized.

skills.name: proj-sources
skills.description: Find and inventory relevant sources for a named project across connected workspace tools, with explicit coverage and access gaps. Use when the user gives a project, initiative, feature, launch, customer, or code name and asks for source links, context, docs, meetings, meeting notes, Slack channels, Notion pages, Google Docs, Google Calendar/Meet events, or other related resource URLs.

skills.name: proj-update
skills.description: Gather project progress and reconcile an Entry Page or plan, then draft a stakeholder update. Also supports log-only reconciliation; accepts existing document platforms and local Markdown.

skills.name: project
skills.description: Prepare and maintain project documents from stakeholder proposal through kickoff, progress updates and closeout. Resume an existing document workflow; excludes product issue decomposition and engineering delivery.
